unresolved_mappings.title: Cranial Nerve Deficits (CN I-XII Localizing Syndromes)
unresolved_mappings.issue: Nerve injury (109-11): Isolated cranial mononeuropathies are a component of objective 109-11 (Nerve injury)'s broader peripheral/cranial nerve injury scope, though 109-11 is framed around traumatic nerve injury rather than the medical causes emphasized here.

unresolved_mappings.title: Nutritional Deficiencies and Toxic Injuries (Neurologic)
unresolved_mappings.issue: Substance use or addictive disorders (103): Alcohol/toxin-related neurologic injury overlaps with objective 103's (substance use disorders) scope, though 103 is framed around the addiction/substance-use encounter rather than the resulting neurologic deficit itself.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease
unresolved_mappings.issue: Major or mild neurocognitive disorders (dementia) (58-3): CJD is a rare, rapidly progressive cause within objective 58-3's broad dementia differential; the objective's key/enabling text does not name CJD specifically.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Apraxia and Agnosia
unresolved_mappings.issue: Cerebrovascular accident and transient ischemic attack (stroke) (41): Apraxia/agnosia can occur as non-dominant/dominant hemisphere cortical stroke findings within objective 41's broader neurologic-deficit scope, but neither is independently named in objective 41's key/enabling text.
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

unresolved_mappings.title: Spinal Cord Syndromes
unresolved_mappings.issue: Spinal trauma (109-13): Traumatic spinal cord injury overlaps objective 109-13's (spinal trauma) scope, but this heading's own content is a pure cross-reference with no independent detail on non-traumatic spinal cord syndromes (which have no dedicated MCC objective).
unresolved_mappings.recommended_action: Coordinator/reviewer to confirm whether this WEAK secondary citation adds value or should be dropped.

note: 5 unit(s) carry WEAK mapping_strength evidence out of 49 total study units, primarily reflecting MCC's presentation-based objective structure not having dedicated objectives for several individually-named neurologic diseases (e.g. multiple sclerosis, Guillain-Barre syndrome, myasthenia gravis, Parkinson disease as a title) - these are instead captured via targeted search-mcc-objectives calls against the broader presentation objectives that reference them (e.g. weakness 117, ataxia 35, numbness 66) at STRONG/MODERATE strength, consistent with NP chapter's precedent for dialysis/transplantation. The WEAK citations recorded here are secondary/contextual evidence retained for traceability on cross-reference-only or thin-content units (Apraxia/Agnosia, Spinal Cord Syndromes, CN Deficits' 109-11 citation, CJD, Nutritional/Toxic 103 citation), not primary evidence for a chapter's core testable content.
